asi.evidence: The existing input sandbox reports only the relative missing read. Seven successful contract violations are silent.
asi.hypothesis: A post-run execution-root inventory and input snapshot will improve recall without requiring ecosystem-specific execution branches.
asi.next: Add a generic validation report that snapshots inputs, inventories writes, and exposes explicit read-observation limitations.

asi.evidence: The eight adversarial cases report with path-specific repairs and the four open-source-inspired controls remain clean.
asi.hypothesis: A validation-only sandbox plus filesystem inventory covers successful writes and literal workspace escapes while preserving the current isolation shape.
asi.next: Add correctness tests and generated references; retain the documented successful-read limitation.

description: Post-run private-root inventory, workspace snapshot, symlink checks, and path-specific preflight repairs

asi.evidence: Forty warmed local-hit runs measured 26.30 ms median with 1.00 ms standard deviation after the full workspace and 241 command-line examples passed.
asi.hypothesis: A committed validated baseline makes allocator, logging, thread, and remote-fetch experiments safely reversible.
asi.next: Test mimalloc, then profile remaining logging and remote round trips.

asi.evidence: Mimalloc measured 25.75 ms in its stable repeat, while the immediately rebuilt system allocator measured 25.13 ms. A separate allocator run was badly distorted by system load.
asi.hypothesis: Page-local allocator sharding helps concurrent workloads, but Once now keeps this fast path mostly on one thread and does not recover the added allocator startup cost.
asi.next: Keep the system allocator and target repeated logging setup, parsing, and remote request dependencies instead.

description: Mimalloc did not beat the system allocator above noise

asi.evidence: Twenty clean-client remote hits measured 176.89 ms median and 175.53 ms mean with a 6.02 ms standard deviation.
asi.hypothesis: Per-request blocking authentication and duplicate initial channel connections add avoidable remote-path latency.
asi.next: Resolve authentication once per process and make channel initialization single-flight.
